# Account Management Guide

## Creating an Account

To create an account, visit our website and click Sign Up. You will
need a valid email address and a password with at least 8 characters
including one uppercase letter, one number, and one special character.

## Account Security

We strongly recommend enabling two-factor authentication (2FA) on your
account. Navigate to Settings > Security > Enable 2FA. We support
authenticator apps (Google Authenticator, Authy) and SMS verification.

## Password Reset

If you forget your password, click Forgot Password on the login page.
A password reset link will be sent to your registered email. The link
expires after 24 hours. If you do not receive the email, check your
spam folder or contact support.

## Account Deletion

To delete your account, navigate to Settings > Privacy > Delete Account.
All personal data will be erased within 30 days of the request.
Remaining store credit will be forfeited upon deletion. Active
subscriptions will be cancelled immediately with no refund for the
current billing period.
